basic_info.description: Perched atop a distinguished 4-unit Edwardian in the vibrant heart of iconic Haight-Ashbury, this top floor 2 bed, 1 bath condo exudes timeless San Francisco charm. Soaring ceilings, bay windows, wainscoting, and a split bath with soaking tub reflect the charm of iconic San Francisco architecture. The layout offers easy, comfortable living with kitchen and cozy family areas close together, a separate office space, and in-unit laundry. The chef's kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a vintage Wedgewood gas stove. Thoughtful amenities include generous detached storage (116 sq ft!) and a shared outdoor patio. Tucked on a tree-lined street, this serene retreat blends historic character with modern convenience. With a near-perfect 97 Walk Score, you're just steps from the best of Upper Haight and Cole Valley  lush parks, cozy cafes, world-class dining, boutiques, and cultural landmarks. Welcome home to a space that inspires, comforts, and connects.
